meta.title: Spice Census
meta.description: An anonymous 7-minute survey about how spicy we are, and how that changes over the years.

landing.title: How spicy are you?
landing.intro: Nobody really knows how kinky people are, or whether that is changing. The Spice Census asks everyone, from totally vanilla to very spicy, the same short set of questions every year. Your answers become part of a long-term trend, and you get a fun result at the end.
landing.point1: About 40 multiple-choice questions. No free text.
landing.point2: No name, no email, no IP address, no cookies. Answers cannot be traced back to you.
landing.point3: Couples welcome: take it separately and compare your results.
landing.point4: At the end: your archetype, your spice profile and the topics you have explored.
landing.contentNote: Content note: this survey asks about sexual preferences and activities in a non-graphic way. You can stop at any time; nothing is saved until you press submit.

gate.question: Are you 18 years or older?

consent.title: Your consent
consent.body: Your answers include information about your sex life, which is specially protected data under the GDPR (Art. 9). We store your answers anonymously, without any information that identifies you, and use them only to research trends in sexual preferences. Aggregated statistics are published. Because the answers are anonymous, a single response cannot be found or deleted later.
consent.checkbox: I agree that my anonymous answers are stored and analysed for this purpose.

core1.intro: How much do you agree? There are no right or wrong answers. Go with your gut.

returning.intro: Optional. With a returning code we can see how answers change for the same (anonymous) person over the years. The code is random, so it says nothing about you.

firecracker.name: The Firecracker
firecracker.description: Curious, bold and up for almost anything. Your spice level is off the charts and your partners never get bored.

explorer.name: The Curious Explorer

spotlight.name: The Spotlight Lover

what.title: What we store
what.body: Your answers to the survey questions, the language you used, the survey version and the month (not the day or time) you submitted. If you opt in to a returning code, we store a one-way hash of that random code. We do not store your IP address, browser details, cookies or any free text.

why.title: Why and on what legal basis
why.body: To research trends in sexual preferences over several years and publish aggregated statistics. Because the answers concern your sex life, we process them only with your explicit consent (GDPR Art. 9(2)(a)).

anonymous.title: Anonymity and deletion
anonymous.body: Your answers cannot be linked to you, so we cannot find, show or delete a single response on request. If you used a returning code, only you know it; we cannot recover it.

processors.title: Service providers
processors.body: The website is hosted by Vercel (EU region Frankfurt) and the database by Neon (EU region). They process data only on our behalf.

sharing.title: Publishing
sharing.body: Monthly aggregated statistics are published with a one-month delay. Groups with fewer than 10 responses are never shown. Researchers can apply for anonymised raw data; returning codes are never included.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can withdraw your consent at any time by not submitting the survey. You have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority.
